# `aitbc market gpu status`

Check the status of a GPU rental and its escrow.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market gpu status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--job-id` | text | — | yes | Job ID |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market gpu status --job-id <job_id>
```
